title: Gradio v5.36.2 blank screen when launching app with a different locale with server side rendering (works in v5.35.0)
body:
### Describe the bug

When running a Gradio app with the latest Gradio version (`5.36.2`) under [uv](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv),  the application launches without any errors but the browser displays a completely blank (black) page and no UI elements are rendered. The same code loads correctly when run directly with python app.py or when using Gradio `v5.35.0` under uv.

### Have you searched existing issues?  🔎

- [x] I have searched and found no existing issues

### Reproduction

```python
import gradio as gr

def greet(name, intensity):
    return "Hello, " + name + "!" * int(intensity)

demo = gr.Interface(
    fn=greet,
    inputs=["text", "slider"],
    outputs=["text"],
)

demo.launch()
```


### Screenshot

_No response_

### Logs

```shell
Nothing is displayed in the terminal or browser console; there are no errors or stack traces.
```

Having the same issue with **Gradio 5.36.2** and German-DE local settings.
Server start happens on WSL2 Ubuntu CLI, gradio app shall be shown on a Windows browser.

**Reproducible** with this **simple .py** file:
'''
import gradio as gr

def greet(name):
    return "Hello, " + name + "!"

with gr.Blocks() as demo:
    gr.Markdown("## Minimal Gradio Test")
    name = gr.Textbox(label="Name")
    output = gr.Textbox(label="Output Box")
    greet_btn = gr.Button("Greet")
    greet_btn.click(fn=greet, inputs=name, outputs=output)

print("Start app on localhost with debug true ...")
demo.launch(server_name="0.0.0.0", debug=True)
'''

**Workflow:**
- run script on WSL2 ubuntu terminal and starting uvicorn server
- open windows browser tab 
- start gradio app with URL http://127.0.0.1:7860
- Start console developer tool with F12 and it shows

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Thank you everyone for reporting and upvoting this issue. It’s clear that many of us are affected, and I personally consider this a serious regression.

I maintain a library that relies on Gradio, and due to this bug I’ve had to pin to `v5.35.0` to keep my services running. Without knowing about this, users upgrading to the latest version may find their apps simply refuse to render, which could impact production deployments.

At this point, it would be helpful to determine whether the root cause lies in uv’s environment handling, Gradio’s webview, or some other interaction. Both uv and Gradio are fantastic tools that we depend on, so I hope the team can shed light on which component needs a fix (or a compatibility workaround). 

Thanks again for everyone’s feedback.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
Hi! It has nothing to do with uv. The bug happens when you launch a gradio app without server side rendering and your browser has a non-english language locale. To avoid the bug while we look into it:

- Change you browser language to english
- Launch the app with server side rendering (set `ssr_mode=True` in `launch()`)
